paragraphs.title: 1. Imports & Configuration
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

from pyspark.sql.functions import (
    array, avg, col, count, explode, lit, row_number, struct,
)
from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, StringType, StructField, StructType
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

# ======== Configuration (edit these as needed) ========
HDFS_BASE_PATH    = "hdfs:///user/maria_dev/ml-100k"
CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE = "movielens_ks"

GENRE_COLUMNS = [
    "unknown", "Action", "Adventure", "Animation", "Children",
    "Comedy", "Crime", "Documentary", "Drama", "Fantasy",
    "Film-Noir", "Horror", "Musical", "Mystery", "Romance",
    "Sci-Fi", "Thriller", "War", "Western",
]

print("Spark version : {}".format(spark.version))
print("HDFS path     : {}".format(HDFS_BASE_PATH))
print("Cassandra KS  : {}".format(CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE))

paragraphs.title: 2. Parse Functions & Schemas
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

def parse_user(line):
    """u.user  : user_id | age | gender | occupation | zip_code"""
    p = line.split("|")
    return (int(p[0]), int(p[1]), p[2], p[3], p[4])

def parse_rating(line):
    """u.data  : user_id \t movie_id \t rating \t timestamp"""
    p = line.split("\t")
    return (int(p[0]), int(p[1]), int(p[2]), int(p[3]))

def parse_movie(line):
    p = line.split("|")
    return tuple(
        [int(p[0]), p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4]] +
        [int(v) for v in p[5:24]]
    )

users_schema = StructType([
    StructField("user_id",    IntegerType(), False),
    StructField("age",        IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("gender",     StringType(),  True),
    StructField("occupation", StringType(),  True),
    StructField("zip_code",   StringType(),  True),
])

ratings_schema = StructType([
    StructField("user_id",          IntegerType(), False),
    StructField("movie_id",         IntegerType(), False),
    StructField("rating",           IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("rating_timestamp", IntegerType(), True),
])

movies_schema = StructType(
    [
        StructField("movie_id", IntegerType(), False),
        StructField("movie_title", StringType(), True),
        StructField("release_date", StringType(), True),
        StructField("video_release_date", StringType(), True),
        StructField("imdb_url", StringType(), True)
    ] +
    [StructField(g, IntegerType(), True) for g in GENRE_COLUMNS]
)

print("Parse functions + schemas ready.")

paragraphs.title: 3. Load Raw Data from HDFS
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

sc = spark.sparkContext

users_rdd   = sc.textFile(HDFS_BASE_PATH + "/u.user").map(parse_user)
ratings_rdd = sc.textFile(HDFS_BASE_PATH + "/u.data").map(parse_rating)
movies_rdd  = sc.textFile(HDFS_BASE_PATH + "/u.item").map(parse_movie)

users_df   = spark.createDataFrame(users_rdd,   users_schema)
ratings_df = spark.createDataFrame(ratings_rdd, ratings_schema)
movies_df  = spark.createDataFrame(movies_rdd,  movies_schema)

users_df   = users_df.dropna(subset=["user_id", "age", "occupation"])
ratings_df = ratings_df.dropna(subset=["user_id", "movie_id", "rating"])
movies_df  = movies_df.dropna(subset=["movie_id", "movie_title"])

print("Users   :",users_df.count())
print("Ratings :",ratings_df.count())
print("Movies  :",movies_df.count())
print()
users_df.show(5, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 4. Explode Genres & Register Temp Views
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

genre_structs = [
    struct(lit(g).alias("genre"), col(g).alias("is_genre"))
    for g in GENRE_COLUMNS
]

movie_genres_df = (
    movies_df
    .select("movie_id", "movie_title",
            explode(array(*genre_structs)).alias("genre_info"))
    .select("movie_id", "movie_title",
            col("genre_info.genre").alias("genre"),
            col("genre_info.is_genre").alias("is_genre"))
    .filter(col("is_genre") == 1)
    .drop("is_genre")
)

users_df.createOrReplaceTempView("users")
ratings_df.createOrReplaceTempView("ratings")
movies_df.createOrReplaceTempView("movies")
movie_genres_df.createOrReplaceTempView("movie_genres")

print("Temp views: users, ratings, movies, movie_genres")
print("movie_genres rows:", movie_genres_df.count())
movie_genres_df.show(10, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 5. Task (i) - Average Rating per Movie
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

movie_average_ratings_df = spark.sql("""
    SELECT
        m.movie_id,
        m.movie_title,
        ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 3) AS average_rating,
        COUNT(*)               AS rating_count
    FROM ratings r
    JOIN movies m ON r.movie_id = m.movie_id
    GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.movie_title
    ORDER BY m.movie_id
""")

movie_average_ratings_df.show(15, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 6. Task (ii) - Top 10 Highest-Rated Movies
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

top_ten_movies_df = spark.sql("""
    SELECT
        m.movie_id,
        m.movie_title,
        ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 3) AS average_rating,
        COUNT(*)               AS rating_count
    FROM ratings r
    JOIN movies m ON r.movie_id = m.movie_id
    GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.movie_title
    ORDER BY average_rating DESC, rating_count DESC, movie_title ASC
    LIMIT 10
""")

top_ten_movies_df.show(10, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 7. Task (iii) - Favourite Genre (Users with 50+ Ratings)
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

# Step A: Active users (rated >= 50 movies)
active_users_df = (
    ratings_df.groupBy("user_id")
    .agg(count("*").alias("rated_movie_count"))
    .filter(col("rated_movie_count") >= 50)
)

# Step B: Genre-level rating counts for active users
user_genre_counts_df = (
    ratings_df.join(movie_genres_df, "movie_id")
    .join(active_users_df, "user_id")
    .groupBy("user_id", "genre", "rated_movie_count")
    .agg(count("*").alias("genre_rating_count"))
)

# Step C: Rank genres per user, pick #1 (tiebreak: genre name)
genre_rank_window = Window.partitionBy("user_id") \
    .orderBy(col("genre_rating_count").desc(), col("genre").asc())

favourite_genres_df = (
    user_genre_counts_df
    .withColumn("genre_rank", row_number().over(genre_rank_window))
    .filter(col("genre_rank") == 1)
    .join(users_df, "user_id")
    .select("user_id", "age", "gender", "occupation", "rated_movie_count",
            col("genre").alias("favourite_genre"), "genre_rating_count")
    .orderBy("user_id")
)

print("Active users (50+ ratings):", active_users_df.count())
favourite_genres_df.show(20, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 8. Task (iv) - Users Under 20 Years Old
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

users_under_20_df = spark.sql("""
    SELECT user_id, age, gender, occupation, zip_code
    FROM users
    WHERE age < 20
    ORDER BY age ASC, user_id ASC
""")

users_under_20_df.show(20, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 9. Task (v) - Scientists Aged 30-40
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

scientists_30_to_40_df = spark.sql("""
    SELECT user_id, age, gender, occupation, zip_code
    FROM users
    WHERE occupation = 'scientist'
      AND age BETWEEN 30 AND 40
    ORDER BY age ASC, user_id ASC
""")

scientists_30_to_40_df.show(20, truncate=False)

paragraphs.title: 10. Write All Results to Cassandra
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

def write_to_cassandra(df, table_name):
    (df.write
       .format("org.apache.spark.sql.cassandra")
       .mode("append")
       .options(table=table_name, keyspace=CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE)
       .save())
    print("  OK  {}.{}".format(CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE, table_name))


print("Writing to keyspace:", CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE)
print("")

write_to_cassandra(users_df,   "users")
write_to_cassandra(ratings_df, "ratings")
write_to_cassandra(
    movies_df.select("movie_id", "movie_title", "release_date", "imdb_url"),
    "movies"
)

write_to_cassandra(movie_average_ratings_df, "movie_average_ratings")
write_to_cassandra(top_ten_movies_df,        "top_ten_movies")
write_to_cassandra(favourite_genres_df,      "favourite_genres")
write_to_cassandra(users_under_20_df,        "users_under_20")
write_to_cassandra(scientists_30_to_40_df,   "scientists_30_to_40")

print("\nAll writes completed.")

paragraphs.title: 11. Validation - Read Back from Cassandra
paragraphs.text:
%spark2.pyspark

def read_from_cassandra(table_name):
    return (spark.read
                .format("org.apache.spark.sql.cassandra")
                .options(table=table_name, keyspace=CASSANDRA_KEYSPACE)
                .load())
